values.note: $26 per site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. One vehicle (a camper and its tow vehicle count as one) included; $8 per extra vehicle per night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/columbine-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night'; last updated September 21, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232381/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232381 (notice 'One vehicle is included in your reservation. Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/columbine-campground ('There are no electric/water/sewer site hook-ups at this campground') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232381 ('All of the sites are non-electric'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 46 sites on two loops, five of them tent-only walk-to sites; 41 take RVs (25 reservable, 16 first-come in the catalog). Parking spurs 25-55 ft and the RV must fit the spur; all back-in. The forest's Campground Status table instead gives a 20-ft 'Max Spur' (see flags).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/columbine-campground ('46 sites on two loops. Five of these sites are suitable for tents only', 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 55 feet') + campsite catalog for 232381 (41 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, 25 reservable / 16 not; 5 WALK TO; Driveway Entry all Back-In), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Water spigots, but RVs may not fill tanks from them. Firewood sold by the campground manager.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232381 ('Other amenities include vault toilets, water spigots and trash service. Bundled firewood is for sale by the onsite campground manager. RV units are not permitted to fill tanks from the water spigots') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/columbine-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 15 - Sept 19 (2027: May 14 - Sept 18), closing 4 days before arrival. 'Limited first-come, first-served sites are available during and outside the reservation season.' 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums (not marked soft); 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. A reserved site must be occupied within 26 hours or it goes first-come; no site swapping.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232381 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4 days; notices quoted) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-19, 2027-05-14 to 09-18), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek Ranger District Campground Status: 'Columbine | 46 | 20' | Reserve Now | $26 | May 15 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-26

note: Two loops at 9,200 ft about 2.5 mi northwest of Central City, off the Peak to Peak Byway; popular with off-roaders, with jeep roads from the campground. The last stretch is rough gravel and dirt (Gilpin CR 3, then FR 176). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $26 (2026, 2027), no hookups, 46 sites to 55 ft, reservable on recreation.gov. Added reservable season 05-15 to 09-19, some sites FCFS (also outside the reservation season), 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night minimums, 14-night limit, all back-in, vault toilets, spigot water (no tank filling). FS page currently shows 'Site Closed' (end of season); the forest's Campground Status table gives the operating season May 15 - Sept 20 (added). Forest Order ARP-CCRD-2015-02 bans dispersed camping along Columbine Road but exempts campground permit holders; no road closure.
flags: Official pages disagree on length: the campground page and recreation.gov say 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 55 feet' (catalog spurs 25-55 ft), but the Arapaho-Roosevelt Campground Status table (fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions) lists Columbine's 'Max Spur' as 20'. Kept 55; if the 20-ft figure is right the campground would fail the 23-ft rule.

Access (no 4WD or high-clearance wording on either page): recreation.gov 'From the town of Central City, follow Gilpin County Route 3 west to NFSR 176.1. NFSR 176.1 access is a rough section of dirt road. County Route 3 is a rough section of gravel and dirt road.' The FS page says only to follow Eureka St. 'until road turns to gravel & follow signs to campground'. A rough mountain dirt road for a 23-ft Class C; AWH may want to judge it.

Entry phone is empty. The FS page gives only the Arapaho-Roosevelt Supervisor's Office 970-295-6600, which is also the Clear Creek Ranger District's listed number (fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices). recreation.gov gives 801-226-3564 as the facility phone and (530) 529-0578 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire lines; no concessionaire is named).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/columbine-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
